propositions: Manifest byte-equality tests fail intermittently under pytest-xdist because git dirty-state (from -dirty suffix) flips between two separate build_manifest calls within a single test when concurrent workers touch the checkout.
_gate_commit_sha shells git status --porcelain per call, introducing a race where the dirty flag is sampled at different times across manifest builds.

test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes and test_manifest_is_deterministic_and_path_independent compare two separately-built manifests without pinning gate_code_version, making them vulnerable to concurrent checkout mutations.
Monkeypatching rebar.signing.gate_code_version to a constant in affected tests eliminates the flake by freezing provenance across all build_manifest calls within the test.
test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes already applies the monkeypatch pattern successfully; the other two byte-equality test sites must adopt it.
